'''Z-Epsilon group''' was a group of three [[Delta-class DX-9 stormtrooper transport|''Delta''-class DX-9 stormtrooper transports]] that served the [[Zaarin coup forces|splinter government]] [[Zaarin's fleet|forces]] of rogue [[Grand Admiral/Legends|Grand Admiral]] [[Demetrius Zaarin]] during the [[Zaarin insurrection]]. It was present at the [[Attack on Omar|First Battle of Omar]].
